## What's Changed
* chore: update reporter version to 0.3.19, it basically fixes the status of wip tests by marking them as other and displays them using an hourglass icon in the html report by @yogeshnikam671 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2494
* feat: show wip remark in coverage console report when there are wip tests by @vedubhat in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2497
* Improve backward compatibility check performance by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2486
* chore: remove match field from CtrfTestMetadata by @vedubhat in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2499
* fix: show WIP count under WIP in the logs logged by Junit execution listener by @yogeshnikam671 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2500
* Implement config updater from legacy V1 and V2 to latest V3 by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2501
* chore: update reporter version to 0.3.21, it brings in latest version of html reporter with wip + success tests filtering bug fix by @yogeshnikam671 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2502


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/compare/2.46.0...2.46.1
